title: Stagiaire Client Management
description: Chez Jellyfish, nous croyons en la force de la diversité des perspectives et de la collaboration inclusive. Nous accueillons les talents qui s'épanouissent au sein d'équipes collaboratives et variées, et qui valorisent les contributions uniques de chacun. Jellyfish est une agence de marketing digital internationale ; une alliance unique de passionnés de tech, d'esprits créatifs et d'experts média et data, tous unis pour accompagner nos clients dans leur transformation digitale. Notre engagement en faveur de la diversité nourrit notre innovation et nos stratégies pour faire bouger les lignes, réinventer l'activation média et créer des histoires percutantes pour nos clients internationaux et leurs consommateurs. Rejoignez-nous pour façonner un avenir où croissance économique et épanouissement personnel vont de pair. Description du poste Rattaché(e) à une Client Partner, vous jouerez un rôle de coordination entre nos clients français et nos équipes d'experts, facilitant la communication pour garantir le bon déroulement des projets de déploiement de campagnes. Au sein d'une équipe dynamique composée de Client Partners, Media Planners, Analysts et Campaign Activators, votre soutien sera essentiel à la croissance et à la fidélisation de nos clients clés. Missions Assister les Client Partners dans le suivi du pipeline de projets, en aidant à identifier les besoins à venir pour l'ensemble de l'équipe. Aider à recueillir les informations auprès des différentes équipes clients pour faciliter le traitement des briefs. Soutenir l'équipe dans le suivi des validations budgétaires et le pilotage des dépenses de campagne, en signalant tout écart ou changement. Organiser des réunions régulières de suivi de projet (status). Vous serez chargé(e) de rédiger les comptes-rendus, de définir les next steps et de veiller à documenter tous les points de vigilance. Participer à la préparation et à l'édition des présentations. Contribuer au reporting client et au suivi des livrables. Développer une connaissance approfondie de notre portefeuille de services et de notre offre marketing intégrée pour identifier à terme les besoins de nos clients et y répondre au mieux. Profil recherché Vous pouvez signer une convention de stage pour un engagement à temps plein d'au moins 6 mois (du lundi au vendredi). Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et disposez d'un niveau d'anglais conversationnel. Vous avez une première expérience de la relation client via un stage, une alternance ou un projet personnel. Vous avez un intérêt prononcé pour les réseaux sociaux, le marketing digital, la publicité en ligne et l'IA. Vous savez adapter vos stratégies et vos plans pour faire face aux imprévus. Vous voyez les défis comme des opportunités et recherchez activement des retours d'expérience pour faire évoluer vos compétences. Vous aimez apprendre à connaître vos clients, bâtir des relations durables et apporter de la valeur ajoutée à leur activité. Remarque : Nous privilégions les compétences, l'expertise et le savoir-être plutôt que le nombre d'années d'expérience ou les diplômes traditionnels. Si vous souhaitez rejoindre notre équipe collaborative, postulez dès aujourd'hui en envoyant votre CV en anglais . Informations complémentaires Rejoignez Jellyfish et découvrez un environnement de travail qui valorise votre évolution, célèbre vos réussites et vous donne les moyens de personnaliser votre cadre de travail selon vos besoins. 💫 Environnement de travail sur mesure : Bénéficiez de jusqu'à 60 % de télétravail et organisez vos journées entre 8h00 et 18h30 grâce à des horaires flexibles. Malheureusement, nous constatons une augmentation de faux recruteurs usurpant l'identité de Jellyfish et utilisant illégalement le nom de notre marque. raw.description:
Job title: Senior Data Engineer

Department: Data team

Reports to: Lead Data Engineer

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Permanent, local and full-time 

Starting date: ASAP 2026

PUR Description 

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

 

About the role 

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices. 

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem. 

 

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to: 

 

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python.

  • Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets.

  • Design and maintain data models supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications.

  • Implement and monitor data quality controls to ensure reliability and accuracy.

  • Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure).

  • Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform).

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.

  • Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices.


We are looking for someone with: 

  • 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, with strong Python skills and experience building production-grade ETL pipelines.

  • Strong SQL expertise and solid understanding of relational and analytical databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) and implementing automated testing for data pipelines.

You'll work at the intersection of developer tools, AI agents, IDE architecture, and product strategy while helping define how software developers work with AI in the future.

We'd love to talk if you have: 

  • Significant software engineering experience as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Technical Lead, or similar senior technical role.

Why this role is unique

Position overview

GitLab is looking for a strategic, commercially minded, and operationally rigorous Director of Customer Success to lead our EMEA Customer Success Management & Architecture (CSMA) and Customer Success Engineering (CSE) organizations.

This leader will own the regional customer-success operating model across relationship management, adoption architecture, technical enablement, customer health, and outcome realization. The role brings together the strengths of CSMA and CSE so customers can move from implementation to adoption, measurable business outcomes, expansion, and renewal with a consistent experience.

You will lead through managers and senior leaders, build a high-performing all-remote organization, and partner closely with Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success Operations.

What you will do

Set the regional customer-success strategy

  • Translate GitLab’s customer-outcomes strategy into a clear EMEA plan for CSMA and CSE.
  • Define the regional engagement model, coverage strategy, segmentation, capacity model, and operating rhythm across dedicated, pooled, and scaled motions.
  • Establish a single view of the customer journey, from onboarding and implementation through adoption, optimization, expansion, and renewal.
  • Ensure the organization consistently connects GitLab adoption to customer-defined business outcomes—not activity, features, or meetings alone.
  • Represent EMEA customer needs and patterns in global Customer Success strategy and planning.

Lead CSMA and CSE as one integrated organization

  • Build strong alignment between CSMA relationship leadership and CSE technical expertise, with clear roles, handoffs, decision rights, and escalation paths.
  • Ensure every appropriate customer has a current success plan with measurable outcomes, milestones, owners, risks, and next actions.
  • Create a consistent approach to adoption architecture, use-case progression, technical enablement, and value realization.
  • Develop scalable programs—such as webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, adoption plays, and executive engagements—that increase customer reach and impact.
  • Partner with Professional Services to create continuity from implementation through adoption, including high-quality handoffs and clear ownership after delivery.
  • Ensure CSE capacity is focused on the moments that most improve adoption, time-to-value, customer health, and expansion readiness.

Drive adoption, outcomes, and GitLab platform value

  • Make product adoption and verified customer outcomes the centre of the operating model.
  • Build the capabilities required to help customers adopt GitLab’s strategic use cases, including GitLab Duo and the Duo Agent Platform where relevant to customer objectives.
  • Use product-usage data, customer feedback, success-plan progress, and health signals to identify risk and prioritize intervention.
  • Establish repeatable plays to accelerate onboarding, remove adoption blockers, increase breadth and depth of use, and support customers in achieving measurable value.
  • Partner with Sales and Renewal Management to turn adoption progress and outcome evidence into a credible expansion and renewal narrative.

Own operational excellence and business performance

  • Establish a disciplined cadence for forecasting, customer health, risk management, pipeline inspection, capacity planning, and performance reviews.
  • Define a balanced scorecard for CSMA and CSE that includes customer outcomes, adoption, retention health, expansion influence, coverage, productivity, quality, and team development.
  • Improve data quality and operational consistency across Gainsight, Salesforce, reporting dashboards, and other systems of record.
  • Ensure customer escalations are handled with clear ownership, appropriate executive engagement, and timely cross-functional coordination.
  • Identify systemic friction in the customer journey and lead continuous-improvement initiatives that scale across EMEA and globally.

Build and develop an exceptional team

  • Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing CSMA and CSE leaders and practitioners across EMEA.
  • Set clear expectations for customer leadership, technical depth, commercial acumen, operational discipline, and collaboration.
  • Create career paths, enablement plans, mentoring programs, and succession plans for both disciplines.
  • Foster an inclusive, accountable, and high-trust culture consistent with GitLab’s values and all-remote ways of working.
  • Use talent, capacity, and organizational design decisions to ensure the team can support a changing portfolio and evolving product strategy.

Partner across the revenue and product ecosystem

  • Build trusted relationships with regional Sales and Renewal Management leaders while maintaining clear accountability for CS-owned outcomes and signals.
  • Partner with Professional Services on shared customer plans, implementation-to-adoption transitions, and services attach opportunities.
  • Bring structured customer insight to Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing, and Enablement.
  • Orchestrate executive engagement for strategic customers and high-severity risks.
  • Collaborate with global Customer Success leaders to standardize what should scale and preserve the regional adaptations that improve customer impact.

What success looks like

  • Customers achieve measurable outcomes and progress through their intended GitLab use cases.
  • CSMA and CSE operate as one coordinated team with clear ownership, effective handoffs, and a consistent customer experience.
  • Adoption, customer health, renewal risk, and expansion signals are visible, accurate, and acted on early.
  • GitLab’s strategic capabilities—including Duo and the Duo Agent Platform—are adopted in ways that align to customer priorities and measurable value.
  • EMEA improves time-to-value, retention health, customer advocacy, and expansion influence.
  • The organization has strong leadership depth, healthy talent pipelines, and a culture of accountability and continuous learning.
  • Operating metrics and forecasts are trusted by regional and global leadership.

What you bring

  • Significant leadership experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, or a related post-sales function in an enterprise SaaS or subscription software business.
  • Experience leading both customer-facing relationship teams and technical customer-facing teams, ideally through managers and senior managers.
  • A track record of improving customer adoption, measurable outcomes, retention, and expansion in complex enterprise accounts.
  • Experience designing or scaling coverage models across dedicated, pooled, digital, or programmatic customer-success motions.
  • Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, success planning, health and risk management, adoption metrics, and renewal/expansion partnership.
  • Ability to lead technical and business conversations with senior customer stakeholders, including executives, technology leaders, and engineering audiences.
  • Strong operational discipline, including forecasting, capacity planning, KPI design, data quality, and inspection cadences.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Support, and Operations.
  • Experience hiring, developing, and retaining distributed teams across multiple countries and cultures.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience with DevSecOps, software development lifecycle, developer platforms, or enterprise technology transformation.
  • Experience leading adoption of AI, developer productivity, security, or platform capabilities.
  • Familiarity with customer-success platforms and revenue systems such as Gainsight and Salesforce.
  • Experience operating in a high-growth, global, all-remote company.
  • Experience building scaled enablement programs, technical communities, or pooled specialist models.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Collaborative communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.

  • Strong product and design judgement: you notice weak hierarchy, inconsistent interactions, and confusing states before a specification points them out

  • Pragmatism and low ego: you can improve rough work from other engineers without turning every implementation choice into a philosophical debate

  • EU or UK citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defence contracts)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with mapping, cartographic, GIS, or other geospatial applications

  • Front-end performance work involving large or real-time datasets

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
 
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
 
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram. 

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer (Segment) who will drive technical success in the pursuit of large and strategic opportunities within their areas of expertise, resulting in increased revenue. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, your key area of responsibility will be driving technical pre-sales success across large and strategic fleet opportunities. You will be responsible for running discovery sessions, technical demos, pilots, and proof-of-concepts, while positioning Geotab solutions by understanding customer business challenges and identifying the best fit. You will also develop segment-specific knowledge contributing to playbooks and knowledge bases, lead strategic projects with partners and third-party integrators, and provide market feedback to Product Management. You will need to work closely with Business Development Managers, Business Segment Managers, Account/Engagement Managers, the Signature Accounts Team, Product Management, and other Solutions Engineering teams.

To be successful in this role you will be a self-starter with strong communication and presentation skills, able to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. In addition, the successful candidate will have a customer-focused mindset, strong problem-solving abilities, and the business acumen to drive revenue through pre-sales engagements.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive knowledge of the Geotab ecosystem, serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to empower end-users and partners (through the channel team) and enhance their understanding of Geotab solutions.

  • Educate and collaborate with the channel team, enabling partners and end-users to optimize their utilization of Geotab's technology, products, and solutions, tailoring the approach to meet their specific needs.

  • Partner with Business Development as the technical prime to drive Geotab's continued growth with large/enterprise fleets.

  • Run technical pre-sales activities ranging from discovery, technical demos, pilots, POC's (but not limited to) enabling enriching customer engagement experience maximizing the chances of a sale.

  • Assess and analyze prospect business challenges, identifying Geotab's viability and defining Geotab solutions to meet those needs.

  • Develop segment knowledge (per segment) contributing to playbooks and knowledge base to drive large/complex prospect opportunities, feeding the channel team to drive partner based opportunities that fall under segment categorisation.

  • Are an expert in one or more segments, consulted by your peers, and work with Segment Managers on go to market strategies.

  • Identify and implement methods for automation and standardization for demonstrations and implementations based on Segment expertise and business requirements.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the company's offerings by providing segment based feedback, through knowledge and customer/prospect engagement to the Product Management teams.

  • Maintain and develop a smooth transition plan to the channel teams, upon acquisition of a prospect to a customer to ensure service and solution goals are met.

  • Collaborate with the Geotab revenue generating teams to identify and deliver effective solutions for customer challenges, by working closely with them and their partners, contributing to sales growth, ecosystem expansion and customer retention.

  • Ensure documentation and reporting of prospective opportunities and projects are tracked using standards (JIRA & Salesforce) to enable communication flows and workload management.

  • Are able to work independently with minimal guidance from your manager, receiving validation on your solution proposals.

  • Lead and oversee strategic projects, collaborating closely with partners, third-party integrators, and customers to ensure seamless implementation, deployment, and success.

  • Mentor and support Solutions Engineers and other team members, sharing knowledge, expertise, and best practices to promote skill development and professional growth.

What you'll bring to this role:

  • 5–8 years of experience in a relevant technical field, such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Engineering Support, Software Development, Automotive Engineering, Data Science, Technical Account Management, or Business Development.

  • Business acumen and a desire to drive revenue growth through prospect and pre-sales engagements.

  • Effective problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, with the capacity to assess customer challenges and propose viable solutions.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including sales, product development, and customer support.

  • A customer-focused mindset, with a commitment to understanding client needs and delivering exceptional service.

  • Experience with sales or business development, with the ability to identify and pursue potential opportunities.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Time management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

  • Proven track record of successful customer engagements, project management, and team collaboration.

  • Experience in mentoring, guiding and leading team members to better solutions.

  • Proven ability to maintain and grow technical knowledge to the level of a subject matter expert.

  • Ability to lead and create training sessions for audiences with a variety of technical backgrounds.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
 
Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.

How we work:

At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!
 
We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Bei voize revolutionieren wir die Pflegebranche mit KI: Mit voize sprechen Pflegekräfte ihre Dokumentation einfach ins Smartphone und unsere KI erstellt automatisch die richtigen Einträge. Das spart jeder Pflegekraft durchschnittlich 39 Minuten pro Tag, verbessert die Dokuqualität und macht ihren Arbeitsalltag deutlich attraktiver.

voize ist YCombinator-funded, wird bereits in über 600 Pflegeeinrichtungen eingesetzt und ist in den letzten 90 Tagen um 100 % gewachsen. Unsere Kunden sparen durch voize jedes Jahr über 3,5 Millionen Stunden – Zeit, die für Menschen statt Papierkram genutzt wird.

Doch das ist nur der Anfang. Mit unserer eigenentwickelten voize KI transformieren wir nicht nur den Pflegealltag, sondern haben auch das Potenzial, in zahlreichen anderen Branchen Mehrwert zu schaffen – von Gesundheitswesen bis hin zu Inspektionen.

Als dynamisches Team vereinen wir cutting-edge Technologie mit sozialem Impact. Und jetzt kommst du ins Spiel!

Deine Mission: Pflegewissen einbringen, KI-Modelle weiterentwickeln

Als Werkstudent:in Data Annotation im Bereich Senior Care beurteilst du, wie gut unsere KI-Modelle den fachlichen Ansprüchen von Pflegekräften gerecht werden. Dein Pflegewissen wird zum Maßstab: Mit deinem Feedback zeigst du uns, wo die Modelle schon überzeugen und wo sie noch nachbessern müssen.

🚀 Dein Daily Business

  • Du teilst dein Wissen rund um Pflegeplanung und analysierst Textdaten mit dem Blick einer Pflegefachkraft

  • Zusammen mit dem Team erarbeitest du konkrete Anforderungen an die Datenqualität

  • Du erkennst Muster in den Daten und formulierst Verbesserungsvorschläge

🤝 Dein Skillset - Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast eine Ausbildung oder praktische Erfahrung in der Altenpflege und kennst dich mit Pflegeplanung aus

  • Du kennst die Arbeitsrealität von Pflegekräften aus der Praxis und kannst dich in ihre Erwartungen hineinversetzen

  • Neugier, wie KI Pflegekräfte im Alltag entlasten kann

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, zuverlässig und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick

  • Bereitschaft, an wöchentlichen Teammeetings teilzunehmen

  • Du bist an einer deutschen Hochschule eingeschrieben und kannst 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten

🌱 Gemeinsam wachsen – was dich bei voize erwartet

  • Praxisnaher Einblick in HealthTech & KI, direkt an der Schnittstelle von Pflege, Technologie und Wandel

  • Remote Work mit der Möglichkeit, von unserem Berliner Office aus zu arbeiten

  • Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten, denn du weißt am besten, wann du am liebsten arbeitest

  • 25 Tage Urlaub – plus frei an deinem Geburtstag

✨ Ready to talk? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! 🚀

  1. Intro Call mit Team lead Data (30min) – Ein lockerer Austausch über dich, deine Motivation und voize

  2. Take Home Exercise (max. 1 Std.) - Du bekommst Einblick in die Aufgaben des Teams

  3. Expertise Deep Dive (45min) – Wir sprechen mit dir über dein Fachwissen und was du bei voize bewegen kannst

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen – ganz gleich, wer du bist oder welchen Hintergrund du hast!

Compensation: €16 per hour

title: Founding Designer (m/f/d)
description: TL;DR – Wir entwickeln KI-gestützte Fachkräfte für das Gesundheitswesen von morgen. Unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna automatisiert bereits heute die Patientenkommunikation in Arztpraxen. Nachdem wir uns als Marktführer in der Zahnmedizin etabliert haben, gehen wir jetzt den nächsten großen Schritt: neue medizinische Fachbereiche, neue Länder, neue Produkte. Als erster Designer oder erste Designerin verantwortest du, wie unsere Brand aussieht und wie sich unser Produkt anfühlt, vom Interface, das Praxen täglich nutzen, bis zu den Assets, die uns neue gewinnen. Wieso praxipal? Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzt. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten. Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten, aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen. Was wir suchen 2+ Jahre Design-Erfahrung über mehrere Disziplinen in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld. Portfolio mit Produkt (UI/UX) und visueller Marken-Arbeit. Sicherer Umgang mit dem modernen Design-Stack und vertraut mit nutzerzentrierten Design Ansätzen (z.B. Design Thinking). Analytics ist Handwerkszeug für dich. Du nutzt aktiv Daten für Design-Entscheidungen. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenmotivation und ein Hang zur Umsetzung statt endlosem Verfeinern. Schnelle Auffassungsgabe für neue Tools, KI-gestützte Workflows und Probleme, die du noch nie gelöst hast. Du bringst unterschiedliche Anforderungen zusammen und machst sie einfach und klar. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (DACH ist aktuell unser wichtigster Markt) und gutes Englisch. Was du tun wirst Du gestaltest die Produktoberflächen unseres Kernprodukts, mit denen Praxen täglich arbeiten. Du machst aus unklaren Problemstellungen klare, nutzbare Flows, gemeinsam mit unserem Product Management und Software Engineering. Du baust und pflegst ein schlankes Design-System, damit das ganze Team konsistent und markenkonform arbeiten kann. Du ownst unsere visuelle Identität und produzierst die Marketing-, Event- und Social-Media-Assets, die unseren Growth-Motor befeuern. Du machst komplexe KI-Technologie für die Nutzer im Gesundheitssystem greifbar. Du hast Taste und hebst die Design-Qualität im gesamten Unternehmen. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

About the role

This position is hybrid and based in our London or Berlin office, with an in-office expectation of three days per week.

n8n is hiring an Enterprise SDR to generate high-quality enterprise pipeline for our DACH business by prospecting into strategic accounts and creating meaningful conversations with technical buyers.

You will run a targeted outbound motion: researching enterprise accounts, identifying the right personas, crafting relevant outreach, qualifying early-stage opportunities, and partnering with Enterprise AEs to build pipeline.

This role suits someone with outbound SDR experience who is curious about technical products, thrives in fast-growing environments, and brings the structure, resilience, and sales acumen needed to engage senior stakeholders across large organizations.

Responsibilities

  • Generate qualified enterprise pipeline by prospecting into strategic DACH accounts

  • Build targeted account plans with Enterprise AEs, including priority companies, personas, pain points, and outreach angles

  • Research technical and business stakeholders across IT, DevOps, SecOps, and related teams to identify where n8n adds value

  • Craft personalized outbound messaging that ties n8n's automation and AI capabilities to account-specific priorities

  • Run outbound sequences across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other channels

  • Qualify prospects through strong discovery covering business needs, technical context, urgency, and fit

  • Partner with Enterprise AEs on clean handoffs, meeting context, and next steps

  • Maintain accurate Salesforce data across accounts, contacts, activities, and opportunities

  • Use Outreach, Salesforce, Apollo, and AI tools to improve prospecting, research, personalization, and follow-up

  • Continuously refine messaging, targeting, and qualification through coaching, feedback, and performance data

Requirements

Must-have

  • German fluency, C1 or higher (native or bilingual speaker)

  • Prior SDR experience, ideally prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts

  • B2B SaaS experience with a working knowledge of pipeline generation, qualification, and sales processes

  • Sales acumen across account selection, qualification, and articulating business value early in the cycle; proficient with structured methodologies such as MEDDPICC

  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to write thoughtful outreach and hold confident conversations with senior stakeholders

  • Emotional intelligence to build rapport quickly and adapt across technical and executive audiences

  • Proactive, self-starting working style with consistent follow-up and ownership of results

  • Based in London or Berlin and able to work from the office three days per week

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, or similar platforms

  • Experience selling to technical personas or strong interest in automation, AI, or developer tools

  • Track record of quota attainment, President's Club recognition, or measurable impact in a previous SDR role

  • Practical use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for research, personalization, or productivity

  • Prospecting experience into large organizations, including identifying buying committees and account priorities

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

raw.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment

About us | LinkedIn

description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership. You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team , whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost. Why is this role interesting? High-impact scope : You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers. Real ownership : You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery. Builder's playground : You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale. Tangible results : Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate. What will you do with us? You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works. You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks. ⭐ Is it you we're looking for? You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you: Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness); Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding; Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on; Are confident with change management , including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating; Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills . Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have. Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use) Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact Have excellent verbal and written communication skills; Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English . Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. For this role we are looking to hire within the D-E level range . Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport . Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people, not roles. Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. Accompagner les prospects à chaque étape du cycle de vente et les transformer en clients Alan convaincus, en collaborant avec des décideurs de haut niveau : DRH, DAF et dirigeants, tous secteurs confondus.

Ce dont tu seras responsable

  • Cycle de vente complet de la prospection à la signature

  • Relations stratégiques : piloter les deals et gérer les relations clients clés

  • Réaliser des démonstrations produit inspirantes et guider les parties prenantes dans le processus d'évaluation

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de nos méthodes et de notre stratégie

  • Participer aux initiatives de croissance

  • Faire partie d'une équipe qui innove constamment

👉 Ecoute le témoignage de Fanny Cibot, Account Executive depuis 5 ans à travers plusieurs équipes.

  • Tu es très organisé(e), structuré(e) et empathique

  • Tu as la capacité à influencer, négocier et gérer des deals complexes

  • Tu as une compréhension approfondie des leviers de valeur dans les modèles économiques à revenus récurrents

  • Tu as une excellente attitude et la capacité de collaborer au sein d'une équipe

  • Tu es basé(e) à (ou prêt(e) à déménager à) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes ou Biarritz et travailleras en mode hybride

Prêt(e) à rejoindre notre équipe ?

Nous recrutons dans la fourchette de niveaux B1-E.

  • Assurance santé complète - prise en charge à 100% pour toi et tes enfants, 90-100% pour les partenaires selon ton pays (contrats permanents uniquement).

  • Transport. Avantages de transport spécifiques au pays.

  • Opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation. Politique de formation très flexible, livres gratuits et budget pour assister et parler lors de conférences si l'opportunité se présente.

  • Croissance personnelle par le coaching : Chez Alan, le coaching n'est pas juste un avantage - c'est au cœur de qui nous sommes. Chaque Alaner est accompagné par un coach dédié dès le premier jour, qui aide à maximiser son impact, nourrir l'engagement, et naviguer les valeurs d'Alan pour développer son plein potentiel.

Note importante : nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles.

Si tu es intéressé(e) par cette opportunité mais ne coches pas toutes les cases, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Tout le monde devrait se sentir libre de postuler car cela ne peut qu'apporter apprentissages ou succès.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Mission

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Scope

⚙️ Platform & automation

  • Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

  • Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access

  • Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

  • Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

  • Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

  • Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

  • Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

  • Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

  • Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

First 3 months

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Own a workstream end-to-end, with an IT Ops teammate working alongside you

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

  • 4-5+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

  • Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

  • You write code: not necessarily as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

  • Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

  • Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

  • Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

  • Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

  • Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

  • Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

  • Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform (Okta Workflows, Rippling, Workato, or something you built yourself)

  • Kandji or another MDM at scale

  • Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

  • Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS)

  • Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

  • Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

  • Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French

Compensation: €61K – €83K • €45K – €120K Equity

description: Participe à notre journée exceptionnelle de recrutement pour rejoindre notre Sales Graduate Program chez Alan ! Tu es diplômé(e) d'un Master avec maximum 2 ans d'expérience et tu souhaites débuter ta carrière dans la vente ? Le jeudi 8 Octobre 2026 , Alan t’invite à une journée de recrutement exclusive dans nos bureaux parisiens. Nous ouvrons seulement 24 places pour participer à cette journée, avec l’opportunité unique de décrocher ton CDI au sein de notre Sales Graduate Program. Saisis ta chance de lancer ta carrière en tant que Business Development Representative (BDR) dès Janvier 2027 (ou selon tes disponibilités) , d’acquérir des bases solides en vente, et de tracer ta voie vers des rôles Sales seniors chez Alan en 18 à 24 mois ! Pourquoi participer ? Vis une expérience unique & décroche ta place dans notre Sales Graduate Program : un véritable tremplin pour propulser ta carrière dans la vente. Plonge dans l’univers d’Alan : découvre notre vision et notre ambition au contact direct de nos Alaners. Bénéficie d’un process rapide & transparent : avec une réponse sous 48h à l’issue de la journée. Plonge au cœur du métier de BDR chez Alan : découvre concrètement ce rôle à travers des mises en situation et des échanges privilégiés avec l’équipe. Le processus de recrutement : 📅 Date de l’événement : Jeudi 8 Octobre 2026 📍 Lieu : Siège d’Alan : 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris ⏰ Date limite de candidature : Jeudi 1 Octobre 2026 📈 Les étapes : Nous étudions toutes les candidatures reçues pour sélectionner les meilleurs profils. Si ton profil est retenu, nous t’appellerons pour t’annoncer la nouvelle et échanger brièvement sur tes motivations. Tu recevras un cas pratique à réaliser chez toi : des questions de motivation et un pitch vidéo à enregistrer. Les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront invité(e)s à rejoindre notre journée exclusive au siège d’Alan, avec au programme une étude de cas et des entretiens. À l’issue de cette journée, nous donnons notre réponse en 48h, et les profils sélectionnés rejoindront l’aventure Alan au sein de notre Sales Graduate Program à partir de Janvier 2027 ! ⭐️ Tout savoir sur notre Sales Graduate Program Le principe ? Sur une période de 18 à 24 mois , nous t’offrons l'opportunité d'évoluer au sein du rôle de Business Development Representative (BDR) en acquérant progressivement des compétences plus avancées dans la vente. Phase 1 : Apprends les bases du métier de BDR : prospection, compréhension du marché, création d’opportunités, échanges avec des décideurs. Phase 2 : Développe ton leadership : en tant que BDR, prends des responsabilités transverses telles que le recrutement, le coaching des nouveaux, l’animation de formations et la gestion de projets. Phase 3 : Spécialise-toi : concentre-toi soit sur la prospection des grands comptes (plus complexes et stratégiques), soit sur les PME, en menant des rendez-vous de découverte et des démonstrations produit. Cette progression au sein du rôle de BDR te permettra de développer des compétences commerciales complètes qui te prépareront à une future mobilité interne en tant qu'Account Executive ou Inbound Sales. Envie d’en savoir plus sur le Sales Graduate Program ? 👉 Découvre les coulisses de la première promotion ici 👉 Découvre l'équipe en vidéo ici 👉 Découvre comment on a conçu le programme ici 👉 Lis le témoignage inspirant de Diane sur pourquoi la prospection est un art stratégique 👉 Explore notre approche unique de la vente 💥 Es-tu notre candidat idéal ? Chez Alan, notre devise est "nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles" : nous valorisons les compétences interpersonnelles plus que techniques. Nous croyons que ton potentiel est ce qui compte vraiment. Tu seras un bon fit pour rejoindre l'équipe Sales d'Alan si : Tu détiens un Master d'une école de commerce, avec jusqu'à deux ans d'expérience professionnelle ; Tu montres un intérêt fort pour la vente, et détiens idéalement une première expérience dans ce domaine Tu es enthousiaste, animé(e) par notre mission, et désireux(se) de partager notre ambition ; Tu es team player, organisé(e), et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément ; Tu es désireux(se) d'apprendre et de grandir dans de nouveaux rôles ; Tu es basé(e) à (ou prêt(e) à déménager à) Paris ou Bordeaux Prêt(e) à rejoindre notre Business Development Representative - Graduate Program ? Pour cette opportunité, nous visons à recruter dans la fourchette de niveau A2-B0 . 🐼 Qui sommes-nous ? La vision d'Alan est de faire de la prévention la nouvelle norme de soin pour tous. Notre mission est d'aider les gens à vivre en bonne santé jusqu'à 100 ans tout en aidant les employeurs à être fiers, transformant les avantages santé d'un centre de coûts en leur investissement le plus précieux. Nous construisons un partenaire santé intégré qui unit harmonieusement assurance et prestations de soins intelligentes en un seul système. En connectant tous les aspects du soin - privé, public et direct consommateur - nous créons une expérience santé centrée sur nos membres. Grâce à un engagement profond, nous donnons à chacun les moyens de surmonter les obstacles de santé du quotidien et de vivre plus sainement. 🚀 Comment on s'y prend ? Les personnes qui rejoignent Alan sont souvent surprises et ravies par notre méthode de travail innovante. Nous avons un ensemble de valeurs culturelles qui guident notre approche du travail : La mission est notre priorité — Nous pensons à long terme et sommes des optimistes méthodiques qui prenons des risques, recherchant avant tout la réussite de notre mission. Responsabilité partagée — Chacun est responsable de ses décisions et de ses résultats. Transparence radicale — Toutes les informations sont accessibles et consignées par écrit, afin que chacun puisse prendre les meilleures décisions de manière asynchrone. En constante évolution — Du feedback direct, positif et bienveillant, associé à une prise en charge de son propre développement personnel. 🙌 Avantages & Bénéfices Chez Alan, nous croyons qu' être en bonne santé est un besoin fondamental, et cela commence avec nos employés. C'est pourquoi les Alaners bénéficient d'un environnement stimulant et d'avantages garantissant qu'ils sont heureux, efficaces et ne passent que du temps de qualité avec leurs collègues. Par conséquent, nous offrons : Récompenses équitables . Des packages d'equity généreux complètent ton salaire de base. Bureau flexible . Espace de bureau incroyable dans notre HQ à Paris ou hub de co-working sponsorisé à Bordeaux. Tous les outils dont tu as besoin . Équipement haut de gamme : Macbook Pro, clavier, support laptop, écran, et casque anti-bruit. Politique de vacances flexible et horaires de travail flexibles . Organise ton temps comme tu le souhaites. Assurance santé complète - prise en charge à 100% pour toi et tes enfants, 90-100% pour les partenaires selon ton pays (contrats permanents uniquement) . Transport . Avantages de transport spécifiques au pays. Opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation. Politique de formation très flexible, livres gratuits et budget pour assister et parler lors de conférences si l'opportunité se présente. Croissance personnelle par le coaching : Chez Alan, le coaching n'est pas juste un avantage - c'est au cœur de qui nous sommes. Chaque Alaner est accompagné par un coach dédié dès le premier jour, qui aide à maximiser son impact, nourrir l'engagement, et naviguer les valeurs d'Alan pour développer son plein potentiel. Congé parental. Congé parental étendu pour tous les nouveaux parents. Note importante : nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles. Si tu es intéressé(e) par cette opportunité mais ne coches pas toutes les cases, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Tout le monde devrait se sentir libre de postuler car cela ne peut qu'apporter apprentissages ou succès. Si tu t'identifies comme une femme : Savais-tu que les recherches montrent que les femmes postulent souvent, uniquement, quand elles remplissent 100% des exigences ? Rappelle-toi, c'est juste un guide, pas une checklist. Nous serons ravis de recevoir ta candidature ! 🔖 Consulte nos pages À propos d'Alan , Medium et Carrières , ainsi que notre blog et page Glassdoor pour plus d'infos. Role Summary and Impact

Senior Associate, Analytics

The Journey Activation department requires a Senior Associate, Analytics to support the Analytics Manager, the Analytics Director, and the rest of the Analytics team to define and deliver best practice Campaign Reporting, Analytics, and Optimization solutions across WPP Media client requirements. The Senior Associate, Analytics will also advise where possible on the appropriate use of technology, and contribute to the identification of new client opportunities.

Combining data and technology to inform analytics and insights for WPP Media’s clients is a crucial part of our commitment to driving better decisions. 

Skills and Experience

  • Support the Analytics Manager, the Analytics Director and WPP Media clients to identify analytical requirements and solve challenges effectively and efficiently, supporting external resource to do this when required.
  • Support the development and delivery of existing and new reporting, BI & Analytics projects, including the response to client briefs, securing and analysing required data, preparing the story and visualisation, and presenting to internal and external stakeholders where necessary
  • Become familiar with the existing Analytics toolset to utilize on client business, including data visualisation technologies (Power BI, Data Studio), reporting and analysis tools (Microsoft Excel, Google BigQuery, Google Analytics), and Data Integration pillars (SQL, Azure), and build an awareness in clients’ business, systems and ways of working.
  • Work within, and help develop, an open, collaborative, progressive day to day culture within Analytics, WPP Media’s clients, and develop strong relationships across the Analytics team, across the wider Journey Activation department and the agency as a whole.
  • Help to support Graduates, Work Experience Students, Interns and other temporary resource in the Analytics team where necessary.
  • Media, data and technology industry experience or awareness
  • Real passion for data, analytics and technology, and for learning new skills
  • An interest in AI – and how it can be used to solve problems
  • Good communication skills, both within WPP Media and externally with clients
  • The ability to distil data into insight and valuable information, and to present back findings in a clear, engaging and meaningful way
  • An understanding or awareness of digital media (adserving, cookies, pixels), data visualisation and dashboarding, web analytics, data manipulation and statistical analysis software
  • Some hands-on experience with relevant technologies (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Data Studio, Datorama, Google Analytics, Advanced Excel, SQL, R) would be useful

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. Aided by support from the broader team, the Partnerships Director will define client’s JBPs with media partners, such as Google, Amazon, Pinterest, Meta and TikTok, to maximise client benefits, and then work to deliver these commercial and strategic benefits, throughout the year.  Cooperation with, and co-ordination of, local and regional market teams will be central to this, to ensure a consistent approach and successful execution of the negotiated benefits.

This role will require high levels of relationship management, strategy, coordination and organization as it will involve management of a complex client and agency structure.

The Partnerships Director will need to gain a deep understanding of our client’s businesses and will need to apply their digital (and to a lesser extent, offline) landscape and strategic knowledge to ensure that the client partnership team delivers the most effective plans to deliver on the client’s objectives and the changing entertainment marketing landscape.

They will be responsible for managing partner relationships with the key digital vendors (Meta, Amazon, Google, etc.) to ensure that our clients gain maximum benefits from trading deals brokered and JBPs. Measurement is a key part of the role, so this role is also responsible for ensuring that digital investment associated with the JBPs is tracked and reported back to the client, to ensure full transparency of pacing versus any investment endeavours in place.

This role reports to the Global Head of Partnerships.

Strategic Skills

  • Develop a strong understanding of media landscape working closely with on and offline Global partners, to ensure first mover opportunities are leveraged for client
  • Support in development and monitoring of opportunities with key vendors in the Diversity, Sustainability and Inclusion space, helping to grow client spend
  • Identify key areas of partnership growth and work collaboratively with client teams, as an extension to their strategy & planning teams, to deliver and activate Global JBPs
  • Support in the deployment and monitoring of Global JBPs, across local markets and regions, to ensure targets are met and value is unlocked

  • Develop and sell partnerships persuasively and with confidence, passion and enthusiasm to both clients and internal stakeholders

Delivery Excellence 

  • Present confidently, with gravitas & impact
  • Proactively share global marketplace updates and work with markets to do the same

New business 

  • Support where needed in new business pitches and proposals, supporting client and strategy teams in content partnership proposals in group pitches

  • Deliver best in class JBPs, ensuring client value, innovation and excellence are delivered
  • Develop global integrated investment strategy and then actively work with regional and local leads to deploy in markets, adapting as needed
  • Work closely with Regional and Market leads to support in roll out of investment frameworks & JBP benefits
  • Develop best in class campaign measurement frameworks and build out case studies of the best case studies, to be socialized within local and regional teams, as well and with the client directly
  • Develop, deploy, and monitor client’s global inclusive marketing investment roadmap, partnering with global strategy and integrations leads
  • Partner with global lead on media quality processes and governance and ensure same rigor applied to all media
  • Actively scout for new opportunities bespoke to the GroupM client set
  • Manage monthly partner investment pacing against agreed JBP endeavours, ensuring correct framework is in place to hit spend thresholds across regions and markets
  • Brief and manage set up of client QBR and JBP reviews coordinating with regions and markets where required

People Responsibilities: 

  • Develop relationships with both clients as well as internally at WPP Media
  • Build trusted relationships with media vendors, proprietary media opcos and internal stakeholder teams
  • Manage, motivate and encourage growth and skillset of junior members of the team

Skills and Experience

  • Leading by example, with integrity and good citizenship
  • Positive and passionate approach that motivates the team

Unsere umfangreiche Projekt- und Unternehmensplattform, basierend auf M365 und insbesondere SharePoint, wird individuell auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zugeschnitten. Werde Teil eines dynamischen Scale-ups, das den Bausektor revolutioniert! Bei uns treffen zwei Welten aufeinander: die Baustelle und die Künstliche Intelligenz. Wir denken Projektarbeit KI-first – von der automatisierten Dokumentenverarbeitung über Copilot-gestützte Projektsteuerung bis zu intelligenten Auswertungen. Wenn du Lust hast, Bauprozesse zu verstehen und sie mit KI neu zu denken, bist du hier richtig. Aufgaben Projektleitung: Verantwortung für die Planung, Steuerung und Überwachung von Projekten, einschließlich Budgetüberwachung und Kundenkommunikation. Projektdurchführung: Implementierung unserer maßgeschneiderten Lösungen in Microsoft 365 und SharePoint. Innovation und Entwicklung: Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform durch den Bau spezifischer Module auf Basis von SharePoint. KI im Projektalltag: Du setzt KI-Werkzeuge wie Microsoft 365 Copilot aktiv ein, um Projektdokumentation, Reporting und Kommunikation zu beschleunigen – und entwickelst daraus wiederverwendbare Standards für das gesamte Team. Nähe zur Baustelle: Du arbeitest eng mit Bauleitung, Kalkulation und Projektentwicklung unserer Kunden zusammen, verstehst deren Abläufe und übersetzt sie in digitale Prozesse. Qualifikation Fachkenntnisse und Erfahrung: IT-Ausbildung oder -Erfahrung im Bausektor, fortgeschrittene SharePoint-Kenntnisse, idealerweise ergänzt durch umfassendes Wissen im M365-Umfeld und entsprechende Microsoft-Zertifizierungen. Erfahrung in der Projektleitung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung von Projekten und im Managen mehrerer Vorhaben parallel. Begeisterung für KI: Du nutzt KI-Tools täglich, hinterfragst alte Arbeitsweisen und hast Freude daran, neue Lösungen auszuprobieren und im Team zu etablieren. Interesse an der Baubranche: Erste Berührungspunkte mit Bau, Immobilien oder Planung – oder die klare Motivation, dich tief in diese Welt einzuarbeiten. Organisationstalent: Hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu managen. Sprachkompetenz: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Motivation und Eigeninitiative: Hohe Eigenmotivation und der Wille zur stetigen Weiterentwicklung. Benefits Wachstumschancen in einem innovativen Umfeld: Arbeite in einem expandierenden Unternehmen mit neuesten Technologien und hochwertiger technischer Ausstattung. Direkte Einflussnahme: Deine Ideen und dein Engagement tragen unmittelbar zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei. Flexibilität und Sicherheit: Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Home-Office-Option und ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag. Motiviertes Team: Ein kollegiales Team, das Lust hat, sich weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsam zu wachsen. ECHO POSTER ist eine Berliner Spezialagentur für Außenwerbung. Seit 2008 bringen wir Plakate, digitale Screens, Guerilla-Aktionen und Sonderbauten in Deutschland, UK und Italien auf die Straße. Unsere Kampagnen hängen nicht in Pitch-Decks, sie hängen in der Stadt. Das ist dein Rohstoff, denn darüber schreiben Medien gern. Aufgaben Du baust unsere Presse- und Medienlisten auf und hältst sie sauber: Fachmedien, Regionalpresse, Blogs, Verbände etc. Du machst aus unseren Kampagnen PR-Showcases. Du hältst nach, was deine Platzierungen bewirken: Erwähnungen, Backlinks, Rankings Du pitchst Gastbeiträge und Cases Du prüfst jede Zielseite auf Qualität, bevor wir anfragen Du monitorst die Wirkung unserer der Placements Qualifikation Du bist immatrikuliert - zum Beispiel in Kommunikation, Marketing, Medien oder Journalismus. Das Fach ist uns weniger wichtig als deine Schreibe Du schreibst sehr gutes Deutsch und traust dich, fremde Menschen anzuschreiben. Per Mail, auf LinkedIn oder greifst, wenn es sein muss auch mal zum Hörer Du arbeitest mit Listen-Disziplin. Eine Outreach-Liste mit 80 Kontakten und sauberem Status macht dir keine Angst, sie macht dir Freude SEO-Grundwissen ist ein Plus, kein Muss. Was ein Backlink ist, solltest du wissen, den Rest bringen wir dir bei Dein Englisch ist gut genug, um auch mal eine UK-Redaktion anzuschreiben Benefits Du lernst Digitale PR und Off-Page-SEO als Handwerk, nicht als Theorie. Du lernst was Prospecting, Pitch, Platzierung und Wirkungsmessung ist Du arbeitest mit Profi-Werkzeugen: Ahrefs, Google Search Console, HubSpot Du erfährst wie eine Werbeagentur von innen funktioniert, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und einem hilfsbereiten Team Deine Arbeit ist keine Übungsaufgabe. Veröffentlichungen haben deinen Fingerabdruck Deine Arbeitszeiten passen sich deinem Stundenplan an Kostenlose Getränke - na logisch und jeden Mittwoch authentischer Thai-Lunch mit dem Team Hardware, mit der du flüssig arbeiten kannst Last but not least - Wer arbeiten kann, kann auch feiern. Team Events gehören selbstverstänlich auch dazu Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte eine Frage: Welches Medium würdest du für eine Außenwerbe-Agentur als erstes anschreiben, und mit welchem konkreten Themenvorschlag?
