title: Recruiter:in (m/w/d) inkl. Bewerbermanagement
description: Wir glauben an die Macht des Feedbacks . FEEDBACKPEOPLE ist eine inhabergeführte Beratung für Management-Diagnostik und Führungskräfteentwicklung. Unser deutschlandweit verteiltes Team aus Berater:innen, Psycholog:innen und Digitalexpert:innen führt Assessment-Center, Management Audits und Development Center durch und begleitet Führungskräfte namhafter Unternehmen in Trainings und Entwicklungsprogrammen. Zu uns gehört auch GrowInTheRole , unser Kölner Start-up für KI-gestützte Gesprächssimulationen – zusammen sind wir rund 30 Kolleg:innen plus Werkstudent:innen und Praktikant:innen. Wir wachsen – und suchen langfristig jemanden, der die richtigen Menschen für uns findet und sie so behandelt, dass sie auch kommen wollen. Du verantwortest den gesamten Weg von der ersten Ansprache bis zur Vertragsunterschrift. Aufgaben Deine Themen bei uns Recruiting : Du besetzt unsere offenen Stellen – erfahrene Consultants, Backoffice-Rollen und Positionen bei GrowInTheRole. Active Sourcing : Du sprichst Kandidat:innen aktiv an, formulierst Stellenanzeigen, die nach uns klingen, und baust einen Talentpool auf. Bewerbermanagement : Eingang, Vorauswahl, Rückmeldungen, Terminkoordination, Absagen und Zusagen – alles in JOIN, und niemand wartet tagelang auf eine Antwort. Auswahlverfahren : Du führst Erstgespräche und bereitest Interviews und Auswahltage mit vor – gemeinsam mit den jeweiligen Hiring Managern: bei Consultant-Stellen die Geschäftsführung, bei Backoffice-Stellen unsere Head of Backoffice, bei GrowInTheRole das dortige Gründungsteam. Rund ums Recruiting : Du pflegst unseren Talentpool und die Kontakte zu Hochschulen, bringst uns als Arbeitgeber auf LinkedIn sichtbar unter und begleitest neue Kolleg:innen bis zum ersten Arbeitstag. KI-Nutzung : Du setzt KI-Tools im Sourcing, Screening und in der Bewerberkommunikation ein – wir probieren gern aus, was funktioniert. Ausstattung : Modernes Notebook und iPhone. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Recruiting-Erfahrung: Du weißt, wie man erfahrene Berater:innen und Backoffice-Kräfte findet und für ein kleines, feines Unternehmen begeistert – und vielleicht hast du auch schon Rollen im Sales oder in der (technischen) Produktentwicklung besetzt. Routine: Du bist mit LinkedIn Recruiter und mit JOIN vertraut (oder einem vergleichbaren Bewerbermanagement-Tool). Selbstorganisation: Du arbeitest eigenständig, priorisierst selbst und hältst, was du zusagst. Sprachkenntnisse : Sehr guter sprachlicher Ausdruck auf Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse sind erwünscht. Urteilskraft : Eine fundierte Einschätzung und den Mut, diese zu äußern – wir suchen keine Terminverwaltung, sondern Sparring für die Frage, wer zu uns passt. Benefits Arbeitszeit : Rund 20 Stunden pro Woche, frei einteilbar – der genaue Umfang ist nach oben wie unten verhandelbar. Homeoffice : Möglich und gelebt. Unser Büro in Greven steht dir offen, Präsenz ist willkommen, aber kein Muss. Aktuell ist ein größerer Standort in Köln geplant. Gestaltungsspielraum : Du baust unser Recruiting als eigenes Thema auf und entscheidest mit, wie wir Kandidat:innen finden und ansprechen. Teamatmosphäre : Augenhöhe, Transparenz und regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche – wir leben, was wir beraten und schaffen ein familiäres Miteinander mit kurzen Wegen und gegenseitiger Unterstützung. Entwicklung : Strukturiertes Onboarding sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Expert:innen für Personalauswahl, Diagnostik und Trainingsformate – du lernst fundierte Auswahlverfahren kennen, führst diagnostische Interviews mit erfahrenen Sparringspartner:innen weiter und baust deine Auswahlkompetenz gezielt aus. Schick uns Lebenslauf, Anschreiben und Zeugnisse über JOIN – wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller Menschen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Associate, Financial Services Documentation
description: With a legacy as a pioneer in the ALSP market, Factor leads the next evolution in legal services through AI-integrated contracting. Factor is the market leader in Integrated Law™, combining the expertise of Traditional Law, the efficiency of New Law, and the close business integration of In-house legal to deliver complex legal work at scale. Factor works alongside corporate legal departments to solve for the ever-increasing demands and complexity of transactional legal work. Our "do while transforming, transform while doing" approach combines specialist expertise, AI-powered solutions, and business process knowledge to deliver better performance, better business and legal outcomes, and a transformed contracting experience. Our clients span Fortune 500 companies including global banks, major pharmaceutical companies and large technology firms. We believe that the more diverse our team becomes — in backgrounds, skills, experiences, and perspectives — the higher our creative potential as a company. We are dedicated to growing a diverse, inclusive company where individuals of all backgrounds thrive. We are comprised of more than 300 lawyers, legal specialists, technologists, and process consultants across Europe and North America – Join us! THE ROLE: We’re looking for an experienced Senior Associate to join our Belfast Office. You will be responsible for reviewing agreements and handling escalations. We’re currently working through a large volume of contracts for a banking client, and we’re looking for someone who has experience negotiating end capital market documentation, specifically ISDA, CSA and Repo agreement types. If you believe in being a team player, can collaborate and communicate well with technical and non-technical audiences while bringing a result-driven, focused, high energy, confident, curious, and most of all fun sense of self, then this is the place for you. Specifically, the Negotiator will: Manage client-facing deliverables to the highest standards of quality Identify risks and issues and develop appropriate mitigation plans Pro-actively manage and monitor execution of deliverables and status Assist with the management of the projects critical path, dependencies, and contingencies Ensure the project stakeholders' expectations are understood and managed Oversee the adherence to all Factor’s Methodologies and quality assurance processes Review large volume of contracts efficiently and accurately, working closely with the team to achieve a high-quality output Read complex agreements, including financial services documents with meticulous attention to detail, while analyzing and extracting key information Lead and train contract review teams, implementing best practice Communicate with clients, maintaining excellent communication skills and a professional and warm approach Effectively and efficiently operate in a deadline driven environment, with high attention to detail, in order to meet client expectations Contribute to building Factor’s proprietary Intellectual Property in the rapidly changing Managed Contracts Services business area Be comfortable in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of autonomy and accountability Be an outstanding team player and embody and live our core values to foster our unique culture QUALIFICATIONS: QUALIFICATIONS: You are adaptable, authentic, accountable, and values-driven. You’re a team player who exhibits personal leadership and leaves things better than you found them. We’re looking for someone who always gives their best and inspires others to do the same. In addition to the above, here are the required skills, knowledge, capabilities, and education for this role: Essential Criteria: Undergraduate degree Independent experience of drafting and negotiating end-to-end ISDA, CSA and Repo agreements necessary Client facing experience within a Professional Services firm and a strong focus on client needs Meticulous attention to detail Strong time management, judgment, decision-making and problem solving skills Thrives in both individual and collaborative team environments High-impact communication and presentation skills Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite (including PowerPoint and Excel. MS Project experience highly advantageous) Organizational fit for the Factor culture - exhibiting the core values of Authenticity, Accountability, Adaptability and Stewardship Legally eligible to work in the country in which the role is located Desirable Criteria: Prime Brokerage experience Additional Information As a member of an ISO Compliant center, the candidate will be required to follow the policies and procedures on Information Security Management System in place at the Center of Excellence and globally at Factor. As a member of the Factor team, the applicant will have access to various company and client assets and will be required to maintain the level of security as identified for each asset. Factor is an Equal Opportunity Employer. For more, visit: factor.law Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Work directly with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, supporting meetings, programme reviews, workshops, and delivery discussions. Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, business development, and external suppliers to keep programmes moving at pace. Track progress, risks, actions, and dependencies, identifying issues early and helping drive them through to resolution. Conduct structured analysis to support programme, commercial, and strategic decisions. Support commercial and programme activities, including delivery planning, customer reporting, change control, and the preparation of proposals. Prepare clear, concise programme materials that enable fast, high-quality decision-making. Take ownership of defined workstreams and increasingly complex responsibilities as you develop in the role. Learn by doing, operating close to real customers, real technology, real constraints, and real delivery pressure. Who you are An ambitious early-career professional with at least 1–2 years of experience in management consulting, DefTech, aerospace, a technology start-up, or another demanding and high-paced environment. Experienced in breaking down complex or ambiguous problems, structuring your thinking, and turning analysis into practical action. Comfortable operating between analysis and execution; you do not want a role confined to producing slides, reports, or recommendations. Fluent or native-level in German and fluent in English, with the confidence to operate in bilingual, cross-cultural settings. A strong communicator who can produce clear, concise, and well-structured written materials. Highly organised, dependable, and able to manage several priorities without losing attention to detail. Comfortable interacting with senior stakeholders, customers, technical teams, and external partners. Curious about how complex programmes succeed commercially, technically, and organisationally. Motivated by responsibility, rapid progression, and visible impact rather than narrow task ownership or rigid hierarchies. Energised by working in a small, fast-moving team where expectations are high and learning is accelerated. Interested in defence, advanced technology, and contributing to European sovereign capability. A background in strategy, operations, engineering, technology, public policy, international relations, or a similarly relevant discipline would be valuable. A finance background is not required. What we offer A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. Daily collaboration with leading experts across engineering, operations, business development, and defence, with genuine opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow. Exposure to the full lifecycle of complex defence programmes, from customer requirements and commercial strategy through to engineering delivery and flight testing. High ownership and autonomy: no time tracking and no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly and feedback from testing and flight drives real decisions. A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. Competitive compensation and real share options aligned with responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions
description: Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly. This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments. What You Will Do Own the product strategy and roadmap for how free users become aware of, experience, and develop intent for Premium, driving consideration, conversion intent, and subscriber growth across segments and markets. Lead the discovery, design, and delivery of subscriber-facing features from early concept through global rollout. Drive experiments that deepen our understanding of what makes users want Premium and measurably move free users closer to a purchase decision. Turn behavioral, funnel, and market data into clear hypotheses, define meaningful success metrics, and build a prioritized experimentation roadmap. Design rigorous A/B experiments to evaluate funnel changes against strong baselines, scaling approaches that demonstrably work across markets and segments. Make pragmatic trade-offs across user value, revenue impact, regional nuance, and operational complexity, knowing when a simple flow change is enough and when a deeper platform capability is needed. Partner with marketing, research, and regional teams to adapt value positioning and messaging for different markets, competitive landscapes, and user needs, including high-growth emerging markets where the path to Premium may look fundamentally different. Communicate strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders, translating funnel mechanics and subscription economics into business impact and strategic direction. Where You'll Be You have a strong track record in product management and have shipped consumer-facing products or features at scale, with experience that translates well to subscription, marketplace, consumer growth, or media environments. You have strong instincts for consumer value and what makes a product feel worth paying for, and understand how perception, positioning, and product experience work together to influence willingness to pay. You can break down the path from awareness to conversion, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and connect product decisions to downstream revenue outcomes such as ARPU, LTV, and net subscriber growth. You're fluent in experimentation and A/B testing and are confident interpreting funnel, cohort, and behavioral analysis to make thoughtful prioritization decisions. You know how to navigate the complexity of a global consumer business across different segments, markets, and competitive dynamics, balancing global consistency with local relevance. You bring strong judgment about when to optimize, when to invest more deeply, and when to leave something alone, balancing user value, revenue impact, and operational cost. You're a clear communicator and collaborative partner across product, design, engineering, marketing, research, data science, and regional teams, and you can align people around shared outcomes. You're comfortable working through open-ended problems, learning quickly through experimentation, and adapting your approach based on evidence. Where You Will Be This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Deine Position

Ob in den Kommentaren unserer Social-Media-Kanäle oder in Bewertungen auf Trustpilot und Google – überall dort entsteht ein Stück öffentliches Bild von 1KOMMA5°. Damit wir dort schnell, passend und im Sinne unserer Marke reagieren, suchen wir dich als Verstärkung für unser Community- und Bewertungsmanagement – mit Gespür für Sprache, Plattformen und den Menschen dahinter.

Community Management & Bewertungsmanagement (dein Hauptfokus)

  • Du unterstützt das Team bei der Community-Betreuung auf Instagram, Facebook, YouTube und LinkedIn in der zeitnahen Beantwortung von Kommentaren und Nachrichten im Ton von 1KOMMA5°
  • Du unterstützt im operativen Bewertungsmanagement: Du screenst neue Bewertungen auf Trustpilot und Google, reportest Auffälligkeiten und hilfst bei der Implementierung entsprechender Maßnahmen
  • Du behältst wöchentlich das relevante Video-Umfeld auf YouTube im Blick, sichtest ausgewählte Kanäle und Beiträge rund um 1KOMMA5° und gibst deine Beobachtungen strukturiert ans Team weiter, damit bei Bedarf schnell die richtigen nächsten Schritte eingeleitet werden können
  • Du unterstüzt unsere Organic Traffic Machine: Direkt nachdem neue Inhalte auf unseren Kanälen live gehen, gehst du aktiv in die Kommentare unserer eigenen Posts, stößt Diskussionen an und sorgst so mit dafür, dass unsere Inhalte zusätzlich an Reichweite und Sichtbarkeit gewinnen
  • Du behältst die Logiken der einzelnen Plattformen im Blick – was auf LinkedIn funktioniert, funktioniert nicht automatisch auf Instagram – und kommunizierst dabei immer im Sinne von 1KOMMA5°
  • Du platzierst unsere Inhalte auch dort, wo sich Gespräche über Energiewende, PV, Wärmepumpen & Co. sowieso schon abspielen – zum Beispiel durch passende, wertstiftende Kommentare auf anderen Accounts

Dein Signature-Projekt: GEO

  • Du übernimmst bei uns das Thema GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) als eigenes kleines Projekt und bringst dich inhaltlich aktiv ein: Du entwickelst mit, wie unsere Social-Media- und Community-Inhalte so formuliert und aufbereitet werden, dass sie auch in KI-gestützten Suchergebnissen und Antworten gut sichtbar sind
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, testest neue Formulierungsansätze und hilfst dabei, GEO nach und nach fest in unsere Content-Erstellung einzubauen

Dein Profil

  • Du bist noch mindestens zwei Semester an einer deutschen Hochschule im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, BW L oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert
  • Du bist selbst viel auf Social Media unterwegs und verstehst intuitiv, wie sich Instagram, Facebook, YouTube und LinkedIn jeweils unterscheiden – in Ton, Format und Zielgruppe
  • Erste Erfahrung im Community- oder Social-Media-Management ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss – wichtiger ist uns dein Gespür für Sprache und Menschen.
  • Du schreibst sicher und stilsicher auf Deutsch, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung mit Social-Media-Management-Tools wie Agorapulse (oder vergleichbaren Tools) ist hilfreich
  • Ein Grundverständnis von SEO bzw. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) ist ein Plus – vor allem aber hast du Lust, dich in dieses Thema als eigenes kleines Projekt einzuarbeiten und es aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Du interessierst dich für die Energiewende und hast Lust, dieses Thema jeden Tag ein Stück greifbarer zu machen

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unserem schicken Showroom in der Hamburger Innenstadt zu arbeiten und/oder remote
  • Einblicke in das Community Managemen t eines der am schnellsten wachsenden CleanTech-Startups Europas
  • Ein Team, das dir Fragen beantwortet, Feedback gibt und dich in die Plattform- und Tool-Logiken einarbeitet
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen
  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur
  • Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass
  • Ob Citybike oder E-Bike – mit unserem Jobrad-Leasing bleibst du flexibel und bist umweltfreundlich unterwegs
  • Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

title: Senior Thermal Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Mission Brief 

You will be responsible for defining the thermal environment and architecture of the vehicle, ranging from detailed thermal modeling and system level coupled loads analyses and to active and passive thermal control design. You will be in charge of the development, execution, and correlation of thermal models using FEM/FDM/FVM tools and test data. The decisions you make will directly support hardware qualification, test planning, and system-level design choices, ultimately enhancing the thermal robustness, performance, and reliability of the vehicle throughout its mission.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Own the vehicle-level thermal architecture, including active and passive thermal control design for the avionic components and payloads
  • Perform Thermal Coupled Loads Analysis and develop detailed thermal models using FEM and/or FVM, FDM methods
  • Develop, execute, and correlate thermal models using tools such as SIMCenter, STAR-CCM+ and Thermal Desktop supported by component tests and flight data
  • Review, assess, and approve component- and assembly-level designs for thermal flight readiness
  • Create and maintain specifications and design documentation such as Fluid Plans, Test Plans and Procedures, Test and Analysis Reports, Instrumentation Plans, Work Instructions etc.
  • Develop tools, workflows, and standards to improve efficiency, consistency, and repeatability across thermal engineering activities
  • Support integration, test, and launch-site operations as subject-matter expert on system thermal performance
  • Support with your expertise other technical departments

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical outcome of complex space missions.  During mission contracting and requirements development, you may work with the sales engineering org to ensure mission requirements are valid and mission scope is adequately defined. Systems Engineers translate higher level requirements down to lower-level requirements, consulting and collaborating with discipline team-leads and subject matter experts where necessary.    

You will be the overall technical lead responsible for "building the right thing" and "building it right". This will include the management of system requirements, technical budgets, and sub-system interfaces.  Your responsibility extends to ensuring there is sufficient verification and testing of the system, and you will take ownership of the technical performance outcomes for the mission. You will be the mission's technical lead for both Spire-internal and external (customer, contractor, etc) teams, working collaboratively with others to resolve technical discrepancies in requirements, specifications, or system performance.   

You will also act as the technical point of contact for Spire's global customers during mission development phases and through on-orbit validation of the space systems, working with Spire project and program managers to provide effective communication where required.   

Your knowledge and experience working across multiple technical disciplines will help you coordinate Spire's technical efforts to ensure ultimate mission success. 
  

Role Responsibilities:  

  • Take overall technical ownership of Spire Space and/or Ground Systems from technical development through on-orbit verification; ensure that we are "building the right thing" and “building it right”. 
  • Lead requirements management for a given mission or program - including development, validation, verification, and change management. 
  • Lead technical risk management for a given mission or program - including identification, qualification, mitigation, and resolution. 
  • Develop top-level requirements and then flow-down to lower-levels, consulting and collaborating with discipline team-leads and subject matter experts where necessary. 
  • Serve as the primary Spire technical POC to customers and contractors - communicating and advocating on behalf of internal technical teams where necessary. 
  • Serve as the customer's technical representative to Spire-internal teams - communicating and sometimes advocating for customer requirements, expectations, and experiences. 
  • Develop working knowledge of Spire's satellite platforms, operations systems, and payloads (both Spire and customer-developed) - including customer APIs and software service interfaces. 
  • Proactively communicate to program/project managers where changes in scope, requirements, expected system performance, or development outcomes impact the mission. 
  • Develop, deliver, and maintain mission documentation required to support programs or missions, including both internal and external (customer- or contractor-facing) documentation. 
  • Support the sales engineering team in the development of technical concepts and budgets, feasibility assessments, requirements, scope, and documentation needed during the sales cycle.  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • BSc in Engineering, Computer Science, equivalent STEM-related subject, or equivalent work experience. 
  • 5+ years of experience working in a technical engineering discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Controls, RF Communications, etc) or as a systems engineer for complex integrated systems. 
  • Comprehensive understanding of space systems, concepts of operations, and remote systems operation.  

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 3+ years of experience as a space systems engineer working across engineering disciplines (Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Controls, Radio/Comms, etc) 
  • Experience developing or integrating RF and optical payloads. 
  • Experience participating in architecture and design of digital systems including ground station networks, data distribution and data processing systems, and spacecraft data handling systems 
  • Experience coordinating or leading diverse technical teams spanning multiple engineering disciplines and time zones 
  • Strong interpersonal skills for building relationships with clients and effectively communicating with other members of cross-functional teams 
  • Strong comprehension skills to enable timely understanding of complex customer requirements and identification of thorough and sometimes unique solutions 
  • Experience in satellite mission design, development, and testing with a clear understanding of major mission design trades and scope drivers (power / payload duty cycle, communications systems / data budgets, ground stations, launch and environmental loads, EMI/EMC, thermal management, etc.)  

 

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying.  #LI-MK1

🚀 Launch Attendance

📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

We improve life on Earth with data from space.

title: Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy
description:
Who/What is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy, you will sit at the center of this mission. You won't just deliver static slides; you will bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives, guiding clients from a focused short-term engagement with Mittelstand manufacturers to multi-phase AI transformations with enterprises. In this role, you will take ownership of cross-functional workstreams, drive data-driven decision-making, and actively shape the digital future of our clients.

 

What you will do:

  • Client advisory & strategy: Work closely with (international) clients to understand their business needs and translate them into data-driven recommendations that support strategic decision-making and business transformation.
  • Data & analysis: Collect, synthesise and iterate data to create actionable insights. You work with a modern, AI-native toolstack - from LLM-powered environments (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and agentic workflow tools (e.g. n8n, Lovable) to coding assistants and automation platforms - and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with SQL or Python remains a plus, but the ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery is what we value most.
  • Project delivery: Take ownership of project workstreams and ensure high-quality, timely delivery in alignment with overall project goals. Work collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams across consulting, data, and tech functions.
  • Data & AI solutions: Support the development of data strategies, AI use cases, and business intelligence solutions, contributing to governance frameworks and implementation roadmaps where relevant.
  • Knowledge sharing & collaboration: Contribute to a strong team culture by sharing knowledge, staying up to date with digital and AI trends, and supporting continuous team development.
  • Business development & thought leadership: Actively contribute to Artefact’s growth in Germany - supporting client proposals, shaping new service offerings, and creating intellectual capital such as frameworks, point-of-views, and benchmarks that strengthen our market position.

 

Candidate Profile

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. 

  • Experience: You have at least 2–3 years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, or in-house corporate strategy roles, with a proven track record of participating in data/AI strategy, cloud transformation, or applied AI/Machine Learning projects.
  • Education: A completed university degree (Bachelor’s or Master's) in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field.
  • Data & AI Fluency: You possess a strong affinity for data management and modern AI technologies. You are familiar with concepts like Generative AI, LLMs, or predictive analytics and are eager to bridge the gap between business needs and AI deployment. Ideally, you have hands-on experience in AI use case conceptualization or data platform tracking.
  • Business & analytical mindset: You combine strong analytical skills with a business-oriented perspective. You enjoy identifying business problems and translating them into practical AI and data-driven solutions.
  • Technical skills: You are confident working with PowerPoint and Google Slides to produce polished client-ready output. More importantly, you know how to leverage AI tools - from LLM environments to agentic workflows - to run analysis, generate insights, and accelerate delivery. Experience with SQL, BI tools, or programming languages is not a requirement, but comfort with structured data and a hands-on attitude toward new tools is expected.
  • Communication & collaboration: You communicate complex technical topics clearly in both German and English. You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating across different levels and functions (e.g., translating requirements between business stakeholders and data scientists).
  • Personal attributes: You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a strong client focus and stakeholder understanding. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving complex problems.
  • Languages: Business-fluent German and English are required - you will participate in client workshops, present to senior stakeholders, and write deliverables in both languages. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

 

Why ARTEFACT?

  • Impactful client work: Work on challenging projects with leading national and international clients across data, digitalisation, and advanced data strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities: We believe in performance over tenure. Your growth is driven by your impact, not your length of service, with clear opportunities to progress and diverse career prospects.
  • Competitive rewards: A strong compensation package including a performance-based bonus, which is paid out half-yearly.
  • Learning & development: Join a team of passionate Data Consultants who actively support each other. You'll learn through diverse projects, collaboration, and exposure to leading experts in the field - including international work.
  • Flexibility & time off: Hybrid working model, 28 days of annual leave, plus your birthday as well as Christmas & New Year's Eve off.

 

This position is based in Berlin or Munich.

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are!

title: Senior Technical Program Manager I
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
Travel: up to 40% within DACH, Benelux, Nordics (an other European countries as needed)
Reports to: Director, Professional Services, EMEA
 

Your Impact

As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you’ll lead high-visibility projects, directly contributing to the development and implementation of solutions that truly make a difference. In this role, you’ll tackle complex challenges, working with some of the most advanced technologies in the industry, including cloud and on-prem platforms, and mission-critical systems. You’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with brilliant minds across professional services, sales, engineering, product, and customer teams to deliver solutions that save lives and enhance public trust.

At Axon, we’re driven by a powerful mission: to protect life, capture truth, and accelerate justice. We’re growing rapidly, and this is your chance to make a lasting impact at a company where innovation meets purpose.


What You’ll Do


Program & Project Management

  • Manage all aspects of complex enterprise-grade product deployments
  • Oversee project milestones, resource planning, scope, timeline, and risk management.
  • Manage cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and on-time delivery.
  • Ensures project milestones and deadlines are met and associated documentation supports customer acceptance for purposes of revenue recognition
  • Support pre-sales scoping and post-sales implementation handoff.
  • Operates with a sense of urgency, accuracy, and detail-orientation, while maintaining consistent lines of communication with all teams involved in each project
  • Maintain customer confidence, especially in high-pressure situations
  • Remain organized and focused on removing obstacles through creativity and adaptation to rapidly changing circumstances

Partner Management

  • Own the relationship with 3rd party integrator and the client throughout the length of the contract

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with Professional Services, Product Managers, and Engineers to align program execution with business goals.
  • Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams to manage change requests, solution feasibility, and roadmap alignment.

Process Improvement

  • Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements to increase deployment speed, quality, and customer satisfaction.
  • Contribute to internal SOPs, implementation playbooks, and best practices.

What You Bring

  • Fluency in both German and English
  • European citizenship is required in order to work with sensitive Government data, willing to undergo a security check
  • 5+ years of experience leading and delivering highly complex programs, with demonstrated success in technical program management.
  • Proven track record of managing enterprise-level software deployments, infrastructure projects, or large-scale enterprise application programs.
  • Deep expertise in delivering complex projects involving cross-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and product.
  • Mastery of program/project management tools and methodologies to track, report, and deliver on objectives. (PMP, PRINCE2, SCRUM)
  • Experience gathering requirements, optimizing workflows, and facilitating change management within teams.
  • Familiarity with software configurations and coding experience (particularly JSON) preferred.
  • Advanced communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill technical concepts for diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in guiding client and internal teams through ambiguity, driving alignment, and executing on shared goals.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. raw.title: SCADA Engineering Manager (m/f/d) – Utility Scale PV & BESS
raw.description:
Overview

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.


Your mission

  • Technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems
  • Supplier management — coordinating SCADA/PPC providers (e.g. Gantner, meteocontrol) and holding them accountable for correct specification, integration and delivery
  • Acting as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and suppliers
  • Testing & commissioning oversight for SCADA, PPC and communication systems
  • Engineering & project coordination across the full plant lifecycle


Your profile

  • Degree in electrical engineering, automation engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
  • Several years of professional experience in SCADA, industrial automation, power plant control, renewable energy, or grid integration
  • Experience with utility-scale PV, BESS, substations, or other power generation assets highly desirable
  • Good understanding of SCADA architectures, industrial communication networks, and plant control systems
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA or comparable
  • Understanding of active power, reactive power, voltage and grid control concepts is an advantage
  • Experience working with grid operators, utilities, or grid compliance requirements highly desirable
  • Proven track record coordinating external technical suppliers and managing complex system interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware, software and communication systems
  • Confident communicator with engineers, customers, suppliers and grid operators
  • Structured working style and a strong ownership mentality — you drive technical topics until resolved
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites, suppliers or customers
  • Driving licence category B
  • Fluent English; German language skills strongly preferred
  • A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented approach to work, with the ability to apply professional expertise effectively in day-to-day activities
  • A commitment to respectful, trusting collaboration and mutual support within the team


What we offer

 

  • Work in a growing, international company with a start-up mindset
  • A workplace in a central location in Saarbrücken with good transport links
  • An open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Flexitime scheme with core working hours
  • Company sports programme (Hansefit)
  • Subsidised parking in the city centre or a travel allowance for public transport

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions. The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites. As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders. Your responsibilities Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work. Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code. Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation. Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure. Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation. Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity. Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance. Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure. Your profile Relevant Tech Skills Required: Python and shell scripting. Linux servers in production. Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker). A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context. Nice to have: S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph). Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools. Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM). Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information. You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks. A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment. Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!). Location: We would prefer the consultant to be based in Berlin to facilitate effective project coordination, technical collaboration and onboarding, particularly during the initial phase of the assignment Terms: We are looking for a senior consultant for 6 months with the possibility of extension to up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements, funding and mutual agreement. title: Lead Data Analyst - Recouvrement & crédit H/F
description: Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech. Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Nous recherchons un·e Lead Data Analyst pour rejoindre notre équipe Recouvrement Dans ce rôle, tu seras chargé·e d’orienter la stratégie de recouvrement B2C en te basant sur l’analyse de nos données client et des opérations de recouvrement. Pour cela, il faudra mesurer l’impact des actions existantes, construire des rapports d’analyse et proposer des orientations stratégiques pour améliorer les taux de recouvrement et gérer le risque crédit. Tu accompagneras les équipes Recouvrement et Finance dans leurs prises de décisions et d’amélioration des processus de recouvrement d’Octopus Energy France. Tu reporteras à la Manager Recouvrement et Risque-Crédit, et travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes recouvrement, ops et finance. Tes missions : Être moteur dans la mise en place de la stratégie et des priorités du recouvrement pour l’entreprise Développer, maintenir et partager des reportings et des analyses data complexes en lien avec la dette, le recouvrement et plus largement la Finance pour Octopus Energy France Être force de proposition sur la mise en place des processus de recouvrement et des mesures de prévention pour garantir une excellente expérience client (par ex. : adaptation de mensualité, échelonnement de dettes) Optimiser les décisions de crédit à partir de la données (A/B tests de workflow, décision de seuils) Modéliser la dette en collaboration avec les différentes équipes Finance en France et Groupe pour du provisionnement Développer la collaboration étroite entre ton équipe et les équipes Data France , et intervenir dans les instances de reporting auprès du COMEX France et du Groupe. title: Principal Project Manager
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.


The Role

As a Principal Project Manager, you will support end-to-end implementations of Celonis’ technology across our largest and most strategic customers. You will articulate Celonis’ product positioning to customers and collaborate with Sales, Partners and Value Engineering to establish Celonis’ Services Value proposition and create statements of work with customers during the pre-sales phase. 

In this role, you will assist customers in understanding how to build best practice and enduring capabilities, are responsible for identifying further Services needs by the customer whilst engaged and responsible for customer satisfaction throughout a customer's engagement with Celonis.

Fluency in German language is required.

The work you’ll do

  • Lead complex transformational customer programs, shape and define the project outcome and then steer towards it.
  • Planning, scheduling, and management of project timelines and activities from project kick-off through to training, ensuring each project is delivered on time and meets the customers' requirements. 
  • Manage resources, schedule, scope and budget on multiple projects by creating and maintaining detailed project plans that emphasize speed to delivery and maximise the efficient use of resources needed to meet the requirements. 
  • Collaboration with senior executives, process owners and technical teams within each customer to understand their goals, objectives and requirements and to ensure their successful implementation. You will be their primary point of contact for product feature requests and escalation of support issues. 
  • Regularly communicate project status, covering key discussion items, action items, risks and issues. Keep projects up to date in the Celonis Professional Services Automation System to enable accurate and timely project and portfolio reporting.
  • Proactively manage and escalate risks and issues internally to Celonis management and externally to customer project sponsors to minimize impact to project success.
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to the implementation team, including partner resources, to ensure Celonis methodology is being followed.
  • Use your experience to contribute to the continual improvement of Celonis Services methods as well as the maturing field expertise and best practices. 

The qualifications you need

  • Client-facing Project Management experience in enterprise software implementations, managing multiple projects concurrently.
  • Extensive experience in project management disciplines, including documenting and maintaining project plans, risk/issue/action logs, and driving problem resolution in partnership with customers and Celonis executives.
  • Strong communication skills and a background in consulting with a proven ability to manage stakeholders and project timelines.
  • Experience in people managing consulting teams both onshore and offshore.
  • Experience in positioning Services, writing proposals and “statement of works” within a complete ecosystem (customers and partners).
  • A history of working with an ecosystem of partners and managed co-delivery.
  • Ability to effectively set and manage customer expectations.
  • Strong analytical skills, especially in applying technology solutions to core business problems.
  • Ability and willingness to be certified in Celonis products.
  • Project management certifications (PMP, Prince2, or Safe/Agile).
  • Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or other related field.

 

 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

title: Director, Pre-Sales Global D&I
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The Director of Pre-Sales, Global Defence & Intelligence (D&I) will be responsible for leading Pre-Sales Solution Architects worldwide. This leader will deliver excellence in technical sales, account strategy, relationship building, and solution architecting tailored specifically to national security, Defence & Intelligence institutions.

The mission of Pre-Sales is to provide trusted technical advice, enabling global defence customers to leverage Earth Observation data and geospatial intelligence to support critical military operations, decision-making, and strategic outcomes.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished people manager, a geospatial expert with strong commercial acumen, and possesses over 10 years of experience in Defence & Intelligence. You possess a deep understanding of government defense customers, complex procurement frameworks, and military command structures.

This is a visible, strategic, and highly influential global role, partnering closely with internal D&I Sales teams, Space Systems, Product Engineering, and trusted defense partner ecosystems to secure complex, large-scale government contracts.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the UK or Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Create the conditions for high performance; recruit, coach, and develop a global team of specialized D&I Pre-Sales Solution Architects.
  • Support global D&I sales teams and partner ecosystems by providing world-class technical sales capability to win new defense programs and expand existing accounts.
  • Apply deep expertise in remote sensing, imagery analytics, and complex data architecture to design solutions supporting Military Operations, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) workflows.
  • Lead high-impact customer engagements, workshops, pilots, and technical demonstrations tailored to defense commanders, intelligence analysts, and procurement officers.
  • Collaborate closely with Global Professional Services, Program Management and Customer Success to conduct rigorous technical assessments, ensuring flawless execution from validation to operational delivery.
  • Feed insights, security requirements, and intelligence use cases directly back to Product and Marketing to shape the product roadmap.
  • Serve as a core member of the Global Pre-Sales & Services leadership team, shaping overarching department strategy and driving execution.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years of supervisory or leadership experience managing and scaling technical sales (Pre-Sales / Solution Architecture) teams.
  • 8+ years of professional experience in a Defence & Intelligence environment.
  • Active Security Clearance (or eligibility to hold suitable clearance for engaging all levels of Military Command).
  • Solid grasp of military planning, intelligence workflows, and how commercial Earth Observation (EO) data integrates into defense decision-making.
  • Experience navigating complex government sales cycles, RFP/RFI processes, and defense contracting frameworks.
  • Fluency in geospatial system architectures, cloud environments/secure deployments, API integrations, and complex data pipelines.
  • Ability to engage senior defense executives, military leaders, and procurement authorities, translating technical complexity into strategic value.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills with a track record of building resilient, high-trust teams.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Military / Veteran Experience: Former active Armed Forces Reserve or veteran intelligence professional.
  • Experience working with Sales Qualification frameworks and methodologies e.g., Challenger Sales, MEDDPICC.
  • Understanding of AI-Driven Geospatial Innovation: Conversant in modern AI/ML capabilities (e.g., automated feature extraction, change detection, foundation models) and skilled at leveraging AI to demonstrate high-value intelligence outcomes to defense customers—moving beyond raw imagery to automated, actionable insights. 
  • Experience co-selling and architecting solutions alongside major defense prime contractors, system integrators, and international allies.

That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

  • Reporting to: Richard Mabey, CEO

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Eimear (our Director of Finance) is heading off on maternity leave, and we're looking for an interim Finance Director to hold the seat for ~8 months (October to May).

This isn't a caretaker role, and it isn't a pure people-leadership role either. You're a player-coach in FP&A, meaning you’ll:

  • personally run the FY27 FP&A cycle end-to-end,

  • partner with other execs as a peer to shape strategy, and

  • coach a Financial Controller and an Analyst on everything else.

Success means:

  1. Own and run the FY27 FP&A cycle end-to-end: budget, monthly reforecast, board packs, monthly exec business reviews.

  2. Partner with the CEO and exec team as a peer, shaping board and investor reporting and influencing strategic finance decisions as they arise.

  3. Lead the finance team, with an active coaching load on month-end.

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

WHO WE LOOK FOR

  • You've worked in a B2B SaaS company for a significant part of the last 2 years.

  • You've personally run a full FP&A cycle end-to-end (budget, reforecasts, board reporting), not just contributed to one someone else owned.

  • You're accounting-literate and can support and challenge a controller, even if you're not the one closing the books.

  • You've been the finance owner in a diligence process. That means you've built the data room and held numbers up under external scrutiny.

  • You've partnered directly with execs and a board; not just reporting numbers to them, but shaping and influencing their decisions.

  • You've led a small finance team.

  • You've been hands-on and energised by rolling up your sleeves.

This job likely isn't for you if:

  • You need time and coaching to grow into the role; we need someone who can land running, our CEO won’t have the time to train you.

  • You'd rather direct than build.

  • High-stakes corporate moments (transactions, diligence, board scrutiny) are unfamiliar territory.

  • You've never partnered with execs or led a team.

  • Your FP&A experience is "supporting" rather than owning.

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser.

Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth.

But our story is just beginning.‍ Read more about our vision for intelligent contract automation.

title: Engineering Manager - DevOps & AI Platform
description: Do you want to lead the engineering functions that decide how a platform screening over a billion dollars of crypto transactions every week is built and run? Are you a DevOps leader fascinated by the possibilities of both agentic software solutions and the usage of agents in the software delivery lifecycle? Are you looking for a values-led company that cares about the growth of its people as much as the strength of its platform? Elliptic is where ambitious people do the most important work of their careers. We are making crypto safe, secure and scalable, preventing global financial crime, exposing bad actors and protecting the world's financial system as it is being revolutionized. This is work your friends will actually want to hear about. You can expect to work in highly empowered teams, with remarkable breadth and the freedom to turn bold ideas into real impact, supported every step of the way by some of the most brilliant people you have ever called colleagues. The impact you will have: This role provides the people leadership for two connected functions at the heart of how Elliptic engineers. On the DevOps side, you keep a latency-sensitive screening platform dependable, cost-effective and scalable as transaction volume and customer expectations grow. On the AI Platform side, you lead the team that acts as Elliptic's centre of excellence for building AI agents, owning the shared frameworks, patterns, MCP management and evaluation capability that every product team draws on. You are a two-way conduit for that centre of excellence: carrying its best practice out to teams, and helping define what those best approaches should be. Reliability remains foundational to everything Elliptic does, and you will champion strong SRE practices across the business, though the SRE function itself sits outside your direct people-management scope. This is a hands-off, strategy and people-leadership role: you lead and grow the people, set the operating model, and make the calls that shape DevOps and AI Platform at Elliptic. What you will do: Lead, grow and develop the people across two functions, DevOps and AI Platform, owning hiring, levelling, coaching and career development for a combined team of roughly twelve engineers. Set the strategy and operating model for DevOps: release safety, developer experience, observability, cost and the scalability of a latency-sensitive screening platform. Lead the AI Platform function as a centre of excellence, owning the people and operating model behind Elliptic's shared agent-building frameworks and patterns, MCP management, evaluation framework and shared AI infrastructure. Act as a two-way conduit for the centre of excellence: disseminate best practice and reusable approaches out to product teams building their own agents, and channel their feedback back to define and improve those approaches. Partner with the AI Platform technical lead and senior engineers to shape technical direction, bringing people leadership and delivery rather than owning the technical vision single-handedly. Own the cost, scalability and efficiency of the infrastructure as volume grows, bringing a FinOps mindset to infrastructure spend. Champion SRE and reliability practices across the business, partnering closely with the SRE function. Support the infrastructure and process maturity needed for certifications such as ISO 27001 and SOC2, working with InfoSec. What you will achieve in the first 6 months: Built trust across both functions and their counterparts, and developed a clear, evidence-based picture of the platform's reliability and cost posture and of how the AI Platform centre of excellence currently works and shares knowledge. Shaped and begun executing a people and hiring strategy across both functions, growing DevOps toward its target and building out the AI Platform and AI infrastructure team. Begun operating as an effective conduit for the centre of excellence, strengthening how agent-building best practice, MCP and evaluation approaches are defined centrally and adopted by product teams. Established a clear point of view on AI SDLC and how the platform enables it, and championed SRE practices across the business. You will be a great fit here if you: Lead through people: you measure your success by the growth and impact of your team, not your own output. Are credible with senior engineers without needing to be the hands-on expert: you ask the sharp question and facilitate the right decision. Are genuinely curious about AI, agents and evaluations, and energised by helping an organisation learn to build with them well. Are honest and pragmatic about timelines and trade-offs, and comfortable owning a long-term build-out across two functions. Care about the mission: providing the infrastructure and intelligence that keep financial institutions safe from crypto crime and sanctions evasion. Our ideal candidate has: A track record of managing DevOps, platform or infrastructure engineers, including hiring and building a growing team. An infrastructure background (cloud, IaC, CI/CD, observability) deep enough to make sound strategic calls and guide senior engineers toward the right ones. Extreme curiosity about AI and budding hands-on experience with AI, agents and evaluations: not necessarily deep expertise, but a real, demonstrated pull toward the space and the judgement to grow into leading it. A strong interest in the nuances of the AI-assisted SDLC, and the conviction that tooling alone does not make engineers more potent. Adoption, practice and guardrails are what turn AI access into real leverage. Kubernetes literacy, grounded in hands-on experience as an engineer, sufficient to reason about the estate and challenge the team's decisions. AI fluency: candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, responsible use of AI in an engineering context and the ability to set team norms for it. We are looking for an active AI promoter who can reason about where AI adds leverage and where it is a liability in a compliance setting. Bonus Points for: Experience leading or building an internal platform, ML platform, developer-experience or enablement function. Hands-on exposure to agent frameworks, MCP, or building and running evaluation frameworks. Experience of a company scaling phase. Exposure to ISO 27001 / SOC2 and what they demand of infrastructure and process. Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems in a regulated or financial context. HODLs Crypto.
